Asymptotic Covariance Matrix for k-Step Transition Probabilities

Source: R/03_pk.R
vcov_pk.Rd

Computes the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix of the row-wise vectorized estimator of the \(k\)-step transition matrix \(P^k\) for an irreducible finite-state Markov chain.

Usage

vcov_pk(x, k, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MarkovChain'
vcov_pk(x, k, ...)

# S3 method for class 'StochMat'
vcov_pk(x, k, ...)

# Default S3 method
vcov_pk(x, k, ...)

Arguments

x

A MarkovChain or StochMat object representing an \(s \times s\) transition matrix \(P\). The associated Markov chain must be irreducible.

k

A positive integer specifying the transition step. Thus, \(k = 1\) corresponds to the one-step transition matrix, \(k = 2\) to the two-step transition matrix, and so forth.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods. Currently unused.

Value

A numeric matrix of dimension \(s^2 \times s^2\) containing \(\Sigma_{\mathbf p^{(k)}}\), where \(s\) is the number of states.

Details

Let \(\widehat P(n)\) denote the empirical estimator of the one-step transition matrix \(P\). Then, for a fixed positive integer \(k\), $$ \sqrt{n} \left\{ \widehat P^k(n) - P^k \right\} \mathrel{\mathop{\longrightarrow}\limits^{d}} W_{P^k}, $$

For which, $$ W_{\mathbf p^{(k)}} = \mathrm{vec}\left(W_{P^k}^{\top}\right) \sim \mathcal N_{s^2} \left( \mathbf 0_{s^2}, \Sigma_{\mathbf p^{(k)}} \right). $$ This function calculates the asymptotic variance covariance matrix $$ \Sigma_{\mathbf p^{(k)}} = M_k \Sigma_{\mathbf p} M_k^{\top}, $$

where $$ M_k = \sum_{i=0}^{k-1} P^i \mathbin{\otimes} \left(P^{k-1-i}\right)^{\top}, $$ and \(\otimes\) denotes the Kronecker product.

The one-step covariance matrix \(\Sigma_{\mathbf p}\) is computed by vcov_p().

References

Gavrilopoulos, G., Trevezas, S., and Votsi, I. (2026). Matrix asymptotic calculus for plug-in maximum likelihood estimators in finite Markov chains. arXiv preprint arXiv:2607.17161. https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.17161. See Proposition 4 for the matrix differential and its Kronecker representation.

Sadek, A., and Limnios, N. (2002). Asymptotic properties for maximum likelihood estimators for reliability and failure rates of Markov chains. Communications in Statistics - Theory and Methods, 31(10), 1837–1861. doi:10.1081/STA-120014916 . See Theorem 4 (p. 1847) for the asymptotic covariance matrix of the k-step transition probabilities.

See also

vcov_p() for the one-step asymptotic covariance matrix.

Examples

P <- StochMat(matrix(c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.7), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
dim(vcov_pk(P, k = 2L))
#> [1] 4 4
identical(vcov_pk(P, k = 1L), vcov_p(P))
#> [1] TRUE
